mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL is rising, but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3%) suggests accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 3% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
